audience.text: Python developers building 3D content pipelines, especially for 3D printing, CAD visualization, and lightweight 3D asset processing.

capabilities.text: Imports OBJ, STL, glTF, glTF Binary, COLLADA, and 3MF files via Scene.open() with automatic format detection from file extension.
capabilities.title: Load multiple 3D formats

capabilities.text: Exports scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF, glTF Binary, and 3MF using Scene.save() with format-specific options for compression and coordinate system handling.
capabilities.title: Export to common 3D formats

capabilities.text: Build meshes from control points, create polygons, and convert primitives to editable meshes using Mesh and related classes.
capabilities.title: Construct and edit mesh geometry

capabilities.text: Build node trees using Node.create_child_node() and Node.add_entity(), with independent Transform properties per node.
capabilities.title: Manage scene hierarchy with transforms

capabilities.text: Assign LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes and configure color and factor properties for rendering.
capabilities.title: Apply materials to 3D entities

capabilities.text: Build animation clips using AnimationClip, AnimationNode, and KeyframeSequence for time-based transformations.
capabilities.title: Support keyframe animation

limitations.text: FBX export is not implemented; FbxExporter.save() and save_to_stream() raise NotImplementedError.
COLLADA export is not reachable through Scene.save() due to exporter lookup order issues.
Scene.render() and the entire aspose.threed.render module raise NotImplementedError.
Texture construction raises NotImplementedError; image-backed textures cannot be created.
Mesh boolean operations (union, difference, intersect) raise NotImplementedError.
NURBS curve evaluation and surface-to-mesh conversion raise NotImplementedError.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic 3D scene creation, modification, and export using a pure-Python API with no external SDK or native runtime.
Supports common 3D interchange formats (OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, 3MF) for interoperability across design and manufacturing tools.
Provides a high-level Scene/Node/Mesh object graph for building and traversing 3D hierarchies with per-node transforms and materials.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for loading, constructing, and exporting 3D scenes without native dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of formats supported beyond those explicitly listed in format:input.* and format:output.* is unclear; some formats may be registered but not functional.
Whether the experimental FBX importer works reliably with real-world FBX files is uncertain due to lack of integration tests.
The behavior of Scene.open() when passed a stream without filename or explicit FileFormat is not fully documented.
The status of PbrMaterial and other shading classes beyond what examples demonstrate is not verified.

workflows.name: Import and inspect 3D scenes
workflows.text: Load OBJ, STL, glTF, COLLADA, or 3MF files using Scene.open() and inspect geometry, nodes, and materials.

workflows.name: Export scenes to 3D formats
workflows.text: Write scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, or 3MF using Scene.save() with format-specific SaveOptions for compression and coordinate system control.

workflows.name: Build meshes from control points
workflows.text: Construct meshes manually via Mesh.control_points and Mesh.create_polygon(), then attach to Scene nodes.

workflows.name: Use parameterized primitives
workflows.text: Create Box, Sphere, Cylinder, and other primitives, then convert them to editable meshes via to_mesh().

workflows.name: Assign materials to entities
workflows.text: Attach LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes and configure diffuse, specular, albedo, metallic, and roughness properties.

workflows.name: Triangulate polygon meshes
workflows.text: Triangulate arbitrary polygons using PolygonModifier.triangulate() for compatibility with formats requiring triangle-only geometry.
